data.one_liner: Combines ListTile with a switch, supporting Material, Cupertino, or custom switch.
data.what_it_does: ListTileSwitch is a single-purpose widget that merges a ListTile with a trailing switch. It offers three switch types and exposes all ListTile properties for easy integration.
use_when: You need a ListTile that toggles a boolean value
You want a quick switch in a list without writing custom code
avoid_when: You need a highly custom switch animation or behavior
You are building a complex form with many interactive elements
strengths: Supports Material, Cupertino, and custom switches
